links.comparator_used: Combined prompting (one prompt performing the whole editing task)
links.outcome: Accuracy of editing physicians' responses (removing identifiable and irrelevant content while keeping medical advice)
links.effect: Incremental prompting proved more accurate than combined prompting; no numeric comparison reported in the abstract (overall, 31 of 40 responses were accurately modified)
links.quote: Challenges included misclassification and incomplete removal, with incremental prompting proving more accurate than combined prompting.

design_hint: incremental vs combined prompt engineering for de-identification
